description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincially operated retail outlet in Rossland, the mountain-biking mecca of the BC Kootenays, offering a full range of wine, beer, spirits, and ciders. For touring cyclists passing through, it serves as a convenient stop to restock beverages after a day on the trails. The Rossland location sits on Columbia Avenue, the town's main commercial corridor.
